import csv,hashlib,json,math,os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")==""
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933").resolve()
previous_path=root/"verification/qwen3_14b_two_closed_training_groups_20260929_1102.json"
previous=json.loads(previous_path.read_text())
assert (previous["model"],previous["closed_training_groups"],previous["requests"],previous["timing_rows"])==("Qwen3-14B",2,320,3545)
group=root/"models/Qwen3-14B/calibration/real/repeat-3"
hashes={}
def read(path):
    hashes[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest();return path.read_text()
assert read(group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").strip()=="complete"
assert read(group/"package_versions.txt")==read(root/"models/Qwen3-14B/calibration/real/repeat-1/package_versions.txt")
counts={"latency_256x128_r1":32,"service_1024x256_r4":64,"saturation_1024x256_inf":64}
rows=[]
for case,n in counts.items():
    path=group/"cases"/case
    assert read(path/"status.txt").strip()=="ok"
    trace=json.loads(read(path/"autobench_trace.manifest.json"))
    native=[json.loads(line) for line in read(path/"benchmark.jsonl").splitlines() if line.strip()][-1]
    assert trace["request_count"]==native["completed"]==n
    phase={1:0,2:0}
    for line in read(path/"TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl").splitlines():
        if not line.strip():continue
        value=json.loads(line)
        if value.get("forward_mode") not in phase or not value.get("request_infos"):continue
        latency=float(value["iter_latency"])
        assert math.isfinite(latency) and latency>0
        phase[value["forward_mode"]]+=1
    rows.append({"repeat":3,"case":case,"completed_requests":n,"prefill_rows":phase[1],"decode_rows":phase[2],"timing_rows":sum(phase.values())})
for path,digest in hashes.items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
result={"at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"model":"Qwen3-14B","closed_training_groups":3,"requests":previous["requests"]+sum(r["completed_requests"] for r in rows),"timing_rows":previous["timing_rows"]+sum(r["timing_rows"] for r in rows),"prefill_rows":previous["prefill_rows"]+sum(r["prefill_rows"] for r in rows),"decode_rows":previous["decode_rows"]+sum(r["decode_rows"] for r in rows),"group3_cases":rows,"group3_package_versions_equal_group1":True,"previous_actual_count_record":str(previous_path),"source_sha256_unchanged":hashes,"fit_prediction_or_gpu_change":False,"claim_scope":"Counts of three closed training groups only; no independent-test accuracy or all-five/model completion claim."}
assert result["requests"]==480
print(json.dumps(result))
